Dear Maxime,
Thank you for reaching out and providing the feedback regarding the signs of oxidation on the copper busbars. We've received your observations and are actively addressing them.
We've already had an internal meeting with our Quality Management (QM) team to discuss the observations. This topic will be a priority for our upcoming product care meeting, scheduled for next Monday. During this meeting, we will thoroughly review the situation, assess any potential safety concerns, and determine the appropriate next steps, including whether replacement or repair of the affected components is necessary.
We will keep you informed as soon as we have further instructions and a clear plan of action following Monday's meeting.
Thank you for your patience and understanding as we work to address this.
With best regards,
